# kitsu

> A Rust terminal coding agent for hosted gateways and local model servers,
> with guarded tools, resumable sessions, automation, and background agents.

The workspace has seven crates: `kitsu` owns CLI/configuration/session
integration; `kitsu-core` owns the agent loop and context budgeting;
`kitsu-providers` owns compatible Chat and native Anthropic Messages adapters;
`kitsu-tools` owns permission-gated tools and command containment;
`kitsu-render` owns terminal/JSONL output; `kitsu-editor` owns shared input
editing; `kitsu-tui` owns terminal lifecycle and inline viewport primitives.

Preserve credential redaction, private-state exclusions, filesystem authority,
and fail-closed command containment. Keep neutral run/session values in core
and physical I/O in adapters. Use local fixtures for provider tests.

Update existing documentation with behavior changes. Plans, cycle receipts,
and audit transcripts belong in issues or pull requests, not the source tree.
